definition: A skeletal reinforcement implant package offered to Tier 3 workers by corponations as a benefit substitute — cheaper than healthcare, marketed as 'investment in your productivity.' Workers joke it's the only raise they'll ever get.
origin: Corporate HR euphemism co-opted as bitter street slang
usage: Used sardonically by mid-tier laborers, especially in Ringo Heavy Industries and Arcturus Defense Solutions workforces
example: Two years on the line and all I got was a bone dividend — my spine's reinforced but my rent's still killing me.
